artifact.subject: Re: TechBridge Strategic Growth Initiative - value case for the quote
artifact.body:
Hi Rajesh,

Thanks for reviewing the proposal and for being direct about the budget concern. I understand the proposal amount for TechBridge Strategic Growth Initiative is above this year's plan, and that you need a stronger internal case.

I want to keep the quoted amount intact for now because it reflects the full scope we proposed. The value picture behind it includes the expected return, the time saved, and the support included.

I can prepare a short summary you can use internally, and I can also discuss how the work might be sequenced without changing the quote. If helpful, let me know which parts of the return case you need to show to your team.

I've copied Mateo so the fit assessment stays aligned.

Best,
Ayo

artifact.subject: Working session to build the TechBridge return case
artifact.body:
Hi Rajesh,

I'd like to set up a short live session with you and Mateo to turn the pricing question into a clear return model.

The quoted amount for TechBridge Strategic Growth Initiative will remain the starting point, and we can use the meeting to test the assumptions behind the expected return, time saved, and support coverage. This should give you material you can take internally and give Mateo a chance to assess fit in the same conversation.

Please send me a few times that work for you and Mateo, and I'll set up the invite.

Best,
Ayo

artifact.subject: TechBridge quote: budget owner and structure check
artifact.body:
Logged: Rajesh replied on 2024-02-28 that the TechBridge quote is higher than this year's plan and hard to justify without a clearer return picture. He also asked whether the structure could be phased or reduced.

Before any response on structure goes to TechBridge, confirm who owns the budget and who can approve the quoted amount. Champion and economic buyer are still unknown. Decide whether a phased scope can be discussed while keeping the quote intact, or whether the amount itself must be revisited.

Next: identify the budget owner, then align the value case and any possible sequencing with that owner.
